errors.text: The proposed CALPHAD–descriptor-ML workflow does not reconstruct the target substitution of liquid-phase EAM by an MTP or the replacement of thermodynamic integration by free-energy perturbation.

The cited Holder-mean ML evidence concerns room-temperature elastic moduli, not melting temperature, entropy of fusion, or heat capacity; it therefore cannot support the claimed ±5% melting-property accuracy.

The hypothesis omits the target free-energy physics: electronic excitation contributions, solid-state short-range-order stabilization, and rapid FEP convergence from the small MTP–DFT energy-difference variance.
No evidence supports the claimed prediction of entropy of fusion and heat capacity, or the assertion that the hybrid method outperforms DFT in accuracy.

The proposed falsification composition is deliberately outside the stated database-validity domain, so failure there would test extrapolation rather than falsify the hypothesis within its claimed boundary.
